newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee says shutdown time unknown.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee says shutdown time unknown.

text.p: Maine Yankee officials will need 24 hours before deciding when to bring the 910 megawatt nuclear power plant back on line, a spokeswoman said.
"It's usually 24 hours before we have a decision when to bring the plant back online," Maureen Brown told Reuters.

Brown said the plant, which operates at about 90 percent of capacity due to limitations imposed by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, shutdown early Wednesday after being tripped during testing. The plant is in stable position in a hot shutdown, she said.
Maine Yankee is 38 percent owned by Central Maine Power, 20 percent by New England Electric System and Northeast Utilities and 22 percent by other New England utilities.
